about: What Dependabot cannot see (.github/dependabot.yml covers the actions and tools/package.json): each version is read from its file by its pattern, never written here, and tools/versions.js compares it with the npm registry's newest stable release old enough to take ('days': a week, two for a script players' browsers load; 'sameMajor': only within the major version the project chose). .github/workflows/versions.yml runs it monthly and opens an enhancement issue for each one behind.

entries.name: peerjs
entries.how: PeerJS loads from cdnjs in every player's browser, so it is what ships to players: take it as "The newest version, unless there is a reason" in docs/developing.md says (its source checked, PEERJS_SRI computed from the verified npm package's peerjs.min.js). Update the address and PEERJS_SRI in net.js, the address in index.html's content security policy, its entry and its bundled packages' in tools/licences.json, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt; then run the online and csp suites.

entries.name: node
entries.how: The exact Node scripts/cloud-setup.sh installs on a cloud machine with an older one (CI's actions/setup-node takes the newest of the same major by itself). Update it there and in tools/licences.json (node and node-linux-x64), and run the suites. A new major is the October move in docs/developing.md, "Node's version", not this.
